name: climate-index-plotter
description: Computes ETCCDI climate indices from the DestinE Climate DT (streamed from Earth Data Hub) and plots, per index, the projected change between a historical period (1999-2014) and a future projection period (2025-2049) as a two-panel absolute and percentage variation map.

edh_api_key.description: Earth Data Hub API key from your DESP account settings. Climate DT requires upgraded DESP access.

model.description: Climate DT model: 'IFS-NEMO', 'IFS-FESOM' or 'ICON'. Applied to both periods.

indices.description: Comma-separated ETCCDI index ids (e.g. 'TXx,FD,Rx1day'), or 'all' for all 27.

aoi_bbox.description: Area of interest as 'west,south,east,north' in degrees. Required unless aoi_shapefile is given.

aoi_shapefile.description: Path or URL to a shapefile/GeoJSON polygon. Results are masked to it; derives the bbox if aoi_bbox is 'none'.

etccdi-plots.description: One PNG per selected ETCCDI index showing absolute and percentage variation between the historical and future periods.
